info.title: aae
info.description: The API of the aae daemon (spec §12). Over TCP every operation needs `Authorization: Bearer <api_token>`; without it the reply is 401 `unauthorized`, an `ErrorReply`.

get.summary: Lists the agents, as `<pack>.<name>` with their harness.

400.description: `bad_request`: the query is malformed

post.summary: Loads the config file as a reload would and reports its errors; changes nothing.

get.summary: The effective config of an agent: one line per value with its layer, and the host layer in one line (spec §6.3).

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: `<pack>.<name>`, or a bare name of the project's own pack.

parameters.name: rig
parameters.description: The rig of the run; its layer counts when given.

400.description: `bad_request`: the query is malformed

404.description: `not_found`: no such project, rig or agent

post.summary:
Reads the config file again: new runs and the schedules take it, running runs keep their snapshot, idle
instances no agent uses any more stop. A file with errors changes nothing (400 with the errors); a change of the
harnesses or the trackers needs a daemon restart (409). A replayed key answers as before and applies nothing.

400.description: `bad_request`: a body unreadable or over 2 MiB, malformed JSON, query or path, or a value the operation refuses

409.description: `rejected`: the core refused the request; the message says why

422.description: `idempotency_key_reused`: the key came with another request

get.summary:
The daemon: its version, process and socket, the journal (last `seq`, failed writes in a row and the last
error), the outbox (depth and age of the oldest row, contracts 3.5), the runs in a turn and whether it stops.

500.description: `storage` or `journal`: the daemon could not read its state

post.summary:
Drains the daemon: no run starts from now on (`daemon.stopping{reason: "drain"}`), and it exits once no run
is in a turn or after `timeout_s`. The reply is `{"seq": <daemon.stopping>, "reason", "active_runs": n}`; a drain
asked while a restart is under way, or the reverse, is refused with 409.

parameters.name: timeout_s
parameters.description: How long the runs in a turn may go on, in seconds (default 300); the daemon stops then anyway.

400.description: `bad_request`: a body unreadable or over 2 MiB, malformed JSON, query or path, or a value the operation refuses

409.description: `rejected`: the core refused the request; the message says why

422.description: `idempotency_key_reused`: the key came with another request

post.summary:
A drain after which the daemon starts again in the same process (`daemon.stopping{reason: "restart"}`);
recovery resumes the runs the drain cut (spec §5.6).

parameters.name: timeout_s
parameters.description: How long the runs in a turn may go on, in seconds (default 300); the daemon stops then anyway.

400.description: `bad_request`: a body unreadable or over 2 MiB, malformed JSON, query or path, or a value the operation refuses

409.description: `rejected`: the core refused the request; the message says why

422.description: `idempotency_key_reused`: the key came with another request

get.summary:
The events as SSE: `id` is the `seq`, `event` the type, `data` the envelope (contracts 1.1). A `seq` rotated
away is `410` with `oldest`, the first `seq` still held; it rotated away while streaming: an event `gap`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first `seq` to send; absent: the events after the last written one (or after `Last-Event-ID`).

400.description: `bad_request`: the query is malformed

410.description: `gap`: the `seq` was rotated away; `oldest` is the first one still held

500.description: `storage` or `journal`: the daemon could not read its state

Lists every harness instance: `{id, kind, harness, fingerprint, state, sessions, capacity, pid, pgid,

Stops an idle instance (`instance.stopped{reason: "operator"}`); one that starts or has sessions is refused
(409), so no attempt loses its process.

`{ next_ready = true }` finds no ready bead to take (spec §10.3).

post.summary:
The finisher: the agent declares the outcome of its attempt (contracts 6.3); the reply is
`{"answer": "accepted"|"stale_attempt"|"run_terminal"|"invalid"}`.

400.description: `bad_request`: a body unreadable or over 2 MiB, malformed JSON, query or path, or a value the operation refuses

422.description: `idempotency_key_reused`: the key came with another request

get.summary:
The live view of a run as SSE: its events as on `/v1/events` (`id` the `seq`); the raw messages of its current
session as `event: harness` with no `id`; `event: lagged` with `{"missed": n}` when the reader fell behind the
session. The stream ends after the run's `run.passed`, `run.failed` or `run.cancelled`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first `seq` to send; absent: from the oldest event held (or after `Last-Event-ID`).

400.description: `bad_request`: the path or query is malformed

410.description: `gap`: the `seq` was rotated away; `oldest` is the first one still held

500.description: `storage` or `journal`: the daemon could not read its state

get.summary:
Lists every trigger on every rig it runs on, with its source and next firing (`next_at`, null for an event
trigger) and whether it is `enabled`.

500.description: `storage` or `journal`: the daemon could not read its state

post.summary:
Switches a trigger on a rig off: neither its schedule nor its events fire it until it is enabled, a hand firing
still does. `{"trigger": name, "enabled": false}`.

400.description: `bad_request`: a body unreadable or over 2 MiB, malformed JSON, query or path, or a value the operation refuses

409.description: `rejected`: the core refused the request; the message says why

422.description: `idempotency_key_reused`: the key came with another request

post.summary: Switches a trigger on a rig back on: `{"trigger": name, "enabled": true}`.

400.description: `bad_request`: a body unreadable or over 2 MiB, malformed JSON, query or path, or a value the operation refuses

409.description: `rejected`: the core refused the request; the message says why

422.description: `idempotency_key_reused`: the key came with another request

post.summary:
Fires a trigger by hand: `{"run": id}`, or `{"skipped": reason, "detail": text}` when it does not start a run
(an overlapping live run, for one).

400.description: `bad_request`: a body unreadable or over 2 MiB, malformed JSON, query or path, or a value the operation refuses

409.description: `rejected`: the core refused the request; the message says why

422.description: `idempotency_key_reused`: the key came with another request

max_runs.description: Runs of the agent at once in its project; null for no limit but the daemon's.

request.description: The id of the open request.

continue_from.description: A terminal run whose last session this run continues (spec §9.3).

formula.description: `name` or `<pack>.<name>`, as the project writes it.

active_runs.description: Runs in a turn, a hook or a preparation: what a drain waits for.

outbox_depth.description: Outbox rows the journal has not acknowledged, and the age of the oldest one.

ErrorObject.description:
`code` for programs, `message` for people; some codes add fields: `oldest` with `gap` (410), `errors` with
`config_error` (400).

ErrorReply.description: An error reply, as every failed operation answers.

text.description: One line per value with its layer.

token.description: The attempt token the session got.

Fired.description:
A trigger fired by hand: `run`, or `skipped` (`overlap`, `depth`, `nothing_ready`, `input_unresolved`,
`rejected`, ...) with `detail` when no run started.

formula.description: As a run start takes it: `<pack>.<name>`, or the bare name in the project's own pack.

Instance.description: A harness instance or service of the registry.

JournalHealth.description: Failed journal writes in a row and the last error.

trigger.description: `<pack>.<name>`, or the name of a project trigger.

Pack.description: A pack; the project's own pack has no version.

Plugin.description: A declared plugin, or an enabled bundled one (no version nor root).

on.description: The events its hooks run on.

restarted_instances.description: The idle instances stopped because no agent of the new config uses them.

Run.description: A run: `RunView` of docs/design/contracts.md §1.3 with where it is, its attempts and its outcome.

oneOf.description: The outcome the current attempt declared; for an exec step `data` is `{exit_code, stdout, stderr}`.

waiting_for.description: What a queued run waits for: `concurrency`, `gate`, `workdir` or `daemon_stopping`.

Started.description:
A run started: `run` is its id; `nothing_ready` (and no `run`) when a bead input `{ next_ready = true }` found
no ready bead.

Trigger.description: A trigger on a rig: `on` for an event trigger, `schedule` and `next_at` for a scheduled one.
